exercises.instruction: Read the descriptions. Which do you say in each situation?

items.cue: 🚗 You’re not going to sell your car, because it’s old and not worth much.
options: If I sell my car, I won't get much money for it.
If I sold my car, I wouldn't get much money for it.

items.cue: 👩 You often see Sarah. A friend of yours wants to contact her.
options: If I see Sarah, I'll tell her to call you.
If I saw Sarah, I'd tell her to call you.

items.cue: 🔥 You don’t expect that there will be a fire in the building.
options: What will you do if there is a fire in the building?
What would you do if there was a fire in the building?

items.cue: 🛂 You’ve never lost your passport. You can only imagine it.
options: I don't know what I'll do if I lose my passport.
I don't know what I'd do if I lost my passport.

items.cue: 🏦 Somebody stops you and asks the way to a bank.
options: If you go right at the end of this street, you'll see a bank on your left.
If you went right at the end of this street, you'd see a bank on your left.

items.cue: 🛗 You’re in a lift. There’s an emergency button. Nobody is going to press it.
options: What will happen if somebody presses that button?
What would happen if somebody pressed that button?

exercises.instruction: Read the descriptions and write sentences beginning If … .

items.cue: 🏨 We’re not going to stay at a hotel.
answers: If we stayed at a hotel, it would cost too much.

items.cue: 🤐 There’s no point in telling you what happened.
answers: If I told you what happened, you wouldn't believe me.
If I told you what happened, you wouldn't believe it.

items.cue: 💼 Sally has no plans to leave her job.
answers: If she left her job, it would be hard to find another one.

items.cue: 📝 Kevin is not going to apply for the job.
answers: If he applied for the job, he wouldn't get it.
